title: From Trajectories to Differentiated Skills: Cognitive Differentiation for Self-Improving Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.23599v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents tackle complex tasks through reasoning and interaction with external environments. Agent skills provide persistent, transferable capabilities that guide task planning, inform contextual decisions, support tool use, and enable executable procedures. Yet existing skill-evolution methods largely organize knowledge around skill artifacts, overlooking the functional heterogeneity within individual skills and its implications for knowledge maintenance and use. Inspired by cognitive science, we propose Cognitive Differentiation in Skill Evolution (CDSE), which evolves a unified skill through four functionally distinct yet coordinated components: Meta, Experience, Tool, and Script. translated_title: 从轨迹到差异化技能：面向自我提升智能体的认知分化
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体通过推理和与外部环境的交互来解决复杂任务。智能体技能提供了持久、可迁移的能力，用于指导任务规划、支持情境化决策、辅助工具使用，并实现可执行的流程。然而，现有的技能演化方法大多围绕技能工件来组织知识，忽视了单个技能内部的功能异质性及其对知识维护和使用的影响。受认知科学启发，我们提出了技能演化中的认知分化，通过四个功能各异但相互协调的组件来演化统一的技能：Meta、Experience、Tool 和 Script。CDSE 从成功和失败的轨迹中提取基于证据的语义梯度，按功能角色对其进行整合，并应用组件特定的更新和验证，实现跨组件协调与自适应调用。
tldr: 提出CDSE框架，将智能体技能认知分化为Meta、Experience、Tool和Script四个功能组件，从成功与失败轨迹中提取语义梯度并按功能角色进行针对性更新、验证与协同调用，从而提升自我改进智能体的技能演化能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes CDSE, a framework that cognitively differentiates agent skills into four functional components (Meta, Experience, Tool, and Script), extracting evidence-grounded semantic gradients from success and failure trajectories and applying component-specific updates, validation, and coordination to improve skill evolution for self-improving agents.
